title: The FREE scraper plugin that you need
description:
Speed was never why scrapers fail.

They get blocked. Or they break.

700x faster sounds great.

But fast doesn't matter if you're flagged.

Most scrapers get caught instantly.

One look at the traffic. Bot detected.

Scrapling doesn't sneak past Cloudflare.

It looks like a real browser.

Same fingerprint. Same headers.

The site can't tell the difference.

And here's the part the demo skips.

Normal scrapers break when a site changes.

New layout. Dead selector. Broken script.

So you rebuild it. Again and again.

Scrapling heals itself.

The page moves, it finds the data anyway.

Like a key that reshapes itself when the lock changes.

Plug it into Claude Code or Codex.

Your agents pull live data.

No blocks. No babysitting.

Fast scrapers were never rare.

Unbreakable ones were.

#scrapling #webscraping #cloudflare #claudecode #codex
